title: Dual-CID model (canonical vs root) not documented at API boundary
description: cid_util.rs::cid_for_article() returns a RAW codec (0x55) CID from canonical bytes; ipld/builder.rs::build_article() returns a DAG-CBOR (0x71) root CID. Both are valid for the same logical article but used for different purposes (deduplication vs IPFS storage). The Message-ID→CID map stores the canonical CID (correct), but the relationship is implicit. A contributor could mistakenly use the root CID as a map key or the canonical CID as an IPFS address. Fix: add module-level documentation explaining the dual-CID model and where each is used.
